summary: Enhance your future with our Pre-Retirement Planning Training Course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to secure a comfortable retirement.
lede: Pre-retirement planning helps people approaching retirement assess readiness and organize income, benefits, healthcare costs, and transition decisions. It is for employees nearing retirement and professionals who support retirement administration, and develops skills in building retirement budgets, calculating income gaps, comparing pension and benefit options, and estimating healthcare costs. Learners also create a readiness scorecard, transition action plan, and organized documentation pack.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who need practical retirement planning support in real working contexts, whether they are managing their own transition or advising others through pension, healthcare, and documentation decisions. Employees within five to ten years of retirement who need a structured planning method. HR benefits specialists managing retirement queries and transition documentation. Payroll administrators coordinating pension deductions, timelines, and benefit handovers. Financial planners helping clients compare retirement income and coverage choices. Retirement administrators supporting plan communication and retirement readiness processes. Compensation and benefits managers overseeing pension and welfare transition issues. Employee relations specialists handling retirement discussions and benefit concerns. Risk and compliance staff reviewing retirement records and documentation controls. Line managers planning succession, handover timing, and workforce replacement. Family office and advisory professionals supporting retirement transition decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a calculator, notebook, and access to recent pension, savings, insurance, or retirement benefit statements if available. A basic spreadsheet skill set helps, especially for retirement budgets, income-gap worksheets, and readiness scorecards.
